svg.text: MARCELLA — WHAT THE ORIGINAL MODEL WAS MISSING
Half sections on the axis, same scale. Left: the original model as found (orange = its surfaces, liquid shaded). Right: the 2026 model. Measured on the model.
ORIGINAL SOURCE
2026 MODEL
FINDINGS → 2026 MODEL
Walls about 1.25 thick (median; 5th percentile 1.17) on a bottle that holds 1780 ml to
the brim.
→ Inner surface rebuilt as the original outer profile offset 3.0 (side) and 6.0 (bottom):
measured 3.00 / 6.00 median.
Liquid modelled as 1636 ml, which is not an EU standard size.
→ 1.5 L (EU standard), brimful 1614 ml, fill line at 111.1 with 7.1 % headspace.
Stopper: glass-on-glass plug 7.3 deep, 0.014 wider than the bore (line-to-line), 482
crossing triangle pairs.
→ Bar-top: original head on a Ø26.9 × 20 synthetic-cork shank, 0.5 radial compression in a
Ø25.9 bore.
Box pocket is the bottle's own shape: seated it sits 0.03 into the tray (8656 crossing
pairs); its opening is 0.05 narrower than below.
→ Pocket re-cut as the bottle's insertion envelope + 1.0: measured clearance 1.00,
flat floor, lid clears by 15.8.
Gold wire: 135 pieces sit on the glass; kept unchanged.
→ Same outer surface, so the wire still sits on it (min gap 0.0000).
Label 'MARCELLA PREMIUM': the visible gold lettering is part of the gold layer and
sits on the glass; a hidden copy as curves floats 8.1–13.8 off it (no surface).
→ Gold lettering kept on the glass as drawn; the hidden curves are not used.
OPEN (not claimed)
• Decoration process for the gold wire and lettering (applied metal or precious-metal print)
on the real glass.
• Cork shank grade and compression to validate with the closure supplier.
• Glass distribution depends on the process (blow-and-blow vs press-and-blow): confirm with
the glassmaker.
• Box: lid hinge/closure, tray lining thickness and the gold ring fixing not detailed.
• A 70 cl edition would scale the bottle ×0.78; not built.
MALINYX · MARCELLA
